title: Client surge alignment retro - 2029-03-19
content:
Purpose: quick retro + alignment after this week's onboarding surge; capture carryovers and immediate capacity decisions.

Attendees: Maya Chen (owner), Ethan Patel, Riley Flores, Noah Singh, Priya Desai, Ava Morales (notes)
Time: 2029-03-19 09:30 PT (30m)

Top-level takeaways:
- Surge workload peaked Thursday with 5 parallel onboards; overall delivery met SLAs but squeezed SE capacity and delayed a couple of config tasks.
- Two customers require dedicated infra (region + VPC) and one needs SOC2 evidence before go-live — this is highest priority for legal/compliance coordination.
- We need a temporary rotation for surge weekends (voluntary, 4 people) and clear escalation path to infra oncall.

Customer states (quick):
1) Northbridge Payroll — STATUS: staging->prod blocked
   - Phase: final validation & security checklist.
   - Blocker: customer legal requested HSM key attestations; we don't have a current template for customer-managed HSMs in private deployments.
   - Action: Priya to spin up HSM checklist draft and tag Infosec by EOD 2029-03-20. (JIRA:PROSERV-4821)
   - ETA: target go-live 2029-03-29 if checklist accepted.

2) AtlasRetail — STATUS: deployed to prod, minor tuning
   - Phase: post-deploy performance tweak. Saw tokenization cost spike on long receipts.
   - Work: Ethan to test batching/quant profiles on dedicated pool and propose 2 quant settings (8-bit/4-bit) to reduce token cost without degrading trust signals.
   - Observation: function-calling outputs occasionally include extra-line noise; Riley to add a short eval promptset for issue reproduction.

3) SageLegal — STATUS: in-progress, privacy gating
   - Phase: private deployment (on-prem pilot).
   - Blocker: network egress rules are stricter than checklist assumed — ops asked for a GRANTED list of endpoints.
   - Action: Noah to coordinate with Platform Eng (ticket INFRA-3309) for explicit endpoint allowlist; target 2029-03-22 for pilot resume.

4) BlueHarbor Analytics — STATUS: onboarding complete, monitoring smoke
   - Phase: post-onboard health. Latency has occasional 95th-percentile spikes during report-generation windows.
   - Mitigation: enable KV prefix caching for the heavy-report route; Priya to coordinate with Serving Runtime to apply caching policy in prod preview by 2029-03-21.

Cross-customer observations (patterns worth noting):
- HSM / KMS attestation requests are becoming common for regulated verticals; need a standard response artifact (template + engagement flow).
- Batching/quantization decisions are sensitive to customer token distribution — we should capture per-customer seed prompts from initial eval to inform quant suggestions.
- Deployment docs assume standard egress; more customers will require whitelists or regional endpoints.

Capacity / resourcing notes:
- This week's surge consumed ~70% of SE scheduled time; on-call escalations added ~6 hours overhead.
- Proposal: temporary "surge pool" of 4 SEs for next 3 weeks (Mar 25 - Apr 14). Rotation to be opt-in; leads to approve.
- Request to Eng Management: short-term contractor bench (2 FTE equivalent) to handle config-only tasks and free up senior SEs for architecture/escorts.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Create an HSM/KMS attestation template and publish in Confluence; owner: Priya; due 2029-03-20.
- Approve AtlasRetail quick quant experiment (Ethan) to run on dedicated pool; if 10% cost reduction, roll to similar retail customers.
- Start surge rotation sign-up today; Riley to publish calendar and opt-in form by EOD 2029-03-19.

Action items (owner / due / ticket):
- Priya Desai — HSM/KMS attestation template + Confluence page — due 2029-03-20 — JIRA:PROSERV-4821
- Noah Singh — coordinate endpoint allowlist with Platform Eng — due 2029-03-22 — JIRA:INFRA-3309
- Ethan Patel — quant/batching experiment for AtlasRetail — due 2029-03-23 — GH:proservices/pull/1293 (test branch)
- Riley Flores — publish surge-rotation calendar and on-call escalation doc — due 2029-03-19 (complete)
- Maya Chen — confirm contractor bench request with Eng Mgrs and Finance — due 2029-03-21
- Ava Morales — capture mini-eval promptsets for AtlasRetail and BlueHarbor and upload to shared folder — due 2029-03-21

Open questions / parking lot:
- Do we offer a standardized "HSM integration" SKU or treat all as professional services? (needs pricing input from Sales)
- Should we add a lightweight infra pre-checker (script) customers can run to validate egress and endpoints before SE kickoff? (platform engineering feasibility check)
- Can we track surge effort as a separate metric in Growth dashboard for better forecasting?

Notes to self / friction points observed this week:
- Too many small blockers had to be escalated to Platform Eng because of missing precheck (time sink).
- Hand-off docs are inconsistent between SEs — create a 1-page onboarding checklist template to speed up the handoff.

Next sync: 2029-03-26 09:30 PT (same channel).
Meet adjourned at 10:00 PT.

Appendix: quick links:
- Confluence runbook (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INTEG/Client+Surge+Runbook
- JIRA board: https://jira.redwood.ai/secure/RapidBoard.jspa?rapidView=78
- GH draft PR (quant experiments): https://github.com/redwood-inference/proservices/pull/1293

End of notes.
